questions.q: An EdgeTX channel is at +50 %, Outputs limits at the defaults. What goes to the module?
options: 1750 µs, CRSF 1500
1756 µs, CRSF 1401
1625 µs, CRSF 1240
1756 µs, CRSF 1756

questions.q: Inputs has expo 40 on roll. The stick is deflected 50 %. What does the mix get?
questions.explain: y = k·x³ + (1 − k)·x = 0.4·0.125 + 0.6·0.5 = 0.35. The flight controller knows nothing about this curve and applies its own rates on top.

questions.q: Why does CH5 get a two-position switch with full travel for ExpressLRS?
options: In every ELRS mode CH5 is sent as one bit, so intermediate switch positions are lost over the air
ELRS treats a CH5 value above the middle as armed, and the margin to the threshold should be large
Betaflight accepts arming only on AUX1
EdgeTX cannot assign three-position switches to channels above CH4
questions.explain: With Arm using: CH5 the module compares the channel with the middle (992 in CRSF units). An "off" of exactly 1500 µs leaves zero margin; 988 µs leaves half the travel.

questions.q: For a model with a flight controller, the EdgeTX ADC filter is…
options: turned on: it removes noise from the stick potentiometers and Hall sensors
turned off: the flight controller does the smoothing
without effect on the channels, it only affects the screen
turned on only at 500 Hz and above
questions.explain: The EdgeTX manual explicitly recommends turning the filter off for models with a flight controller: the flight firmware already has RC smoothing, and a second filter adds latency.

questions.q: After Discover new the list has only 1RSS, 2RSS, RQly, RSNR, ANT, RFMD, TPWR, TRSS, TQly, TSNR. What is missing, and why?
questions.fragment:
Telemetry / Sensors
1RSS  -62dBm
2RSS  -64dBm
RQly  100%
RSNR  9dB
ANT   1
RFMD  27
TPWR  25mW
TRSS  -60dBm
TQly  100%
TSNR  10dB
options: The link is not established: rebind the receiver
No flight controller data: its telemetry is off or the wire to the receiver's RX is not connected
The CRSF speed between radio and module is too low, and the module drops the battery and GPS sensor frames
Battery sensors appear only after arming
questions.explain: These ten sensors are link statistics, produced by the receiver and the module themselves. RxBt, Curr, Capa, GPS, FM come from the flight controller over the flight controller TX → receiver RX wire.

questions.q: With the CRSF protocol, the built-in alarms (Low alarm 45, Critical alarm 42) are compared with…
options: 1RSS, the signal level at the first antenna, dBm
RQly, LQ in percent
TPWR
RSNR
questions.explain: In telemetry/crossfire.cpp the radio's "RSSI" for CRSF is RX quality. 45 % LQ is too late, so LQ is announced with your own logical switch with a threshold of 70–80.

questions.q: Logical switch L01: a<x, RQly, 70. The link is lost completely. What happens to L01?
options: True: the radio keeps the last received RQly value, and it was below 70
False: without telemetry, switches on sensors do not trigger
True for the Duration, then false
It keeps the state it had before the loss
questions.explain: In switches.cpp a condition with a sensor source returns false while no telemetry is coming in. A complete loss is announced by the built-in "telemetry lost".

questions.q: F1000 is selected in the ELRS Lua script, but the Status line in the module settings shows 500 Hz. The cause?
options: Dynamic power is on
The CRSF speed of 400k is too low for F1000, and the module lowered the rate itself
The aircraft's receiver supports only modes up to 500 Hz, and the module adjusted to it
The model was copied, and the Receiver No. matches
questions.explain: ELRS 4.1 limits the packet rate by UART speed: 115k up to 250 Hz, 400k up to 500 Hz; by the code F1000 works from 921k, and the ELRS documentation recommends 1.87M for it. The ELRS documentation suggests 400k up to 250 Hz and 921k up to 500 Hz.

questions.q: A quadcopter model was copied with Duplicate for a second aircraft. What do you do first?
options: Recalibrate the sticks
Change Receiver No. and check Model Match
Delete all telemetry sensors and run Discover new again
Change the channel order to TAER
questions.explain: A copy inherits the receiver number. With the same number (or with Model Match off) the second model controls the first aircraft with its own switches.

questions.q: Where in EdgeTX do you set failsafe for an ELRS receiver connected to the flight controller over CRSF?
options: Model Setup → Failsafe mode: Custom, with positions for each channel
Nowhere in the radio: the receiver goes silent, the flight controller defines the behavior
Special function SetFailsafe
Outputs → Min/Max of each channel
questions.explain: The Failsafe mode item exists only for protocols where the receiver stores the positions (FrSky D16/ACCESS, R9M, Flysky, some MPM). For CRSF it does not exist at all.
